title: Questions 160-161 refer to the following letter.
passage_1:
Northgate Leisure Trust
24 Riverside Parade
Bristol, BS1 4QT

10 March

Ms Claire Whitfield
87 Elm Terrace
Bristol, BS6 5LN

Dear Ms Whitfield,

We are writing to inform you that the Fairhaven branch of Northgate Leisure Trust will be installing several new ventilation units in the roof space of the building. This work is part of our wider commitment to providing a healthier training environment for our valued members.

Please note that from 20 March to 22 March, the main sports hall will be closed, and only the annexe with the fitness machines will remain open. If you need to book a class or speak to an instructor in person, please stop by one of our other locations.

We apologise for any inconvenience this temporary disruption may cause and appreciate your continued custom.

Yours sincerely,
Peter Ellery
Centre Manager, Northgate Leisure Trust
